cues.en: But when they were a bit older,

cues.en: And in a lot of ways, this is how you would master a lot of things in life.

cues.en: In a martial art, you would practice the white belt skills

cues.en: you go on to the more advanced one.

cues.en: But what we point out --

cues.en: this is not the way a traditional academic model is structured,

cues.zh: 也就是我们大多数人从小成长的那种学术模式。
cues.en: the type of academic model that most of us grew up in.

cues.zh: 在传统的学术模式中，
cues.en: In a traditional academic model,

cues.zh: 我们把学生分组，通常按年龄，
cues.en: we group students together, usually by age,

cues.zh: 到了初中左右，
cues.en: and around middle school,

cues.zh: 按年龄和所认定的能力分组，
cues.en: by age and perceived ability,

cues.zh: 然后我们带着他们所有人以同样的节奏一起前进。
cues.en: and we shepherd them all together at the same pace.

cues.zh: 通常会发生什么呢？
cues.en: And what typically happens,

cues.zh: 假设我们在初中的预备代数课上，
cues.en: let's say we're in a middle school pre-algebra class,

cues.zh: 当前单元是指数，
cues.en: and the current unit is on exponents,

cues.en: the teacher will give a lecture on exponents,

cues.zh: 然后我们回家做作业。
cues.en: then we'll go home, do some homework.

cues.zh: 第二天早上，我们会回顾作业，
cues.en: The next morning, we'll review the homework,

cues.zh: 然后再讲课、做作业、讲课、做作业。
cues.en: then another lecture, homework, lecture, homework.

cues.zh: 这样持续大约两三周，
cues.en: That will continue for about two or three weeks,

cues.zh: 然后我们迎来一场考试。
cues.en: and then we get a test.

cues.zh: 那场考试中，也许我考了75分，
cues.en: On that test, maybe I get a 75 percent,

cues.zh: 也许你考了90分，
cues.en: maybe you get a 90 percent,

cues.zh: 也许你考了95分。
cues.en: maybe you get a 95 percent.

cues.en: And even though the test identified gaps in our knowledge,

cues.zh: 我有25%的内容没掌握。
cues.en: I didn't know 25 percent of the material.

cues.zh: 就算是优等生，他们不懂的那5%是什么？
cues.en: Even the A student, what was the five percent they didn't know?

cues.zh: 尽管我们已经找出了缺口，
cues.en: Even though we've identified the gaps,

cues.zh: 整个班级接着就会进入下一个主题，
cues.en: the whole class will then move on to the next subject,

cues.zh: 很可能是一个更进阶的主题，而这些缺口正是它的基础。
cues.en: probably a more advanced subject that's going to build on those gaps.

cues.zh: 可能是对数或负指数。
cues.en: It might be logarithms or negative exponents.

cues.zh: 这个过程持续下去，你立刻就会开始意识到
cues.en: And that process continues, and you immediately start to realize

cues.zh: 这有多奇怪。
cues.en: how strange this is.

cues.zh: 我连25%的更基础的东西都不懂，
cues.en: I didn't know 25 percent of the more foundational thing,

cues.zh: 现在却被推着去学更高级的东西。
cues.en: and now I'm being pushed to the more advanced thing.

cues.zh: 这会持续数月、数年，一直到某个时刻，
cues.en: And this will continue for months, years, all the way until at some point,

cues.zh: 我可能在上代数课或三角课
cues.en: I might be in an algebra class or trigonometry class

cues.zh: 然后我撞墙了。
cues.en: and I hit a wall.

cues.zh: 这不是因为代数本身有多难
cues.en: And it's not because algebra is fundamentally difficult

cues.zh: 也不是因为学生不聪明。
cues.en: or because the student isn't bright.

cues.zh: 而是因为我看到一个方程式，他们在处理指数
cues.en: It's because I'm seeing an equation and they're dealing with exponents

cues.zh: 而我不懂的那30%就冒出来了。
cues.en: and that 30 percent that I didn't know is showing up.

cues.zh: 然后我就开始走神了。
cues.en: And then I start to disengage.

cues.zh: 想体会这有多荒谬，
cues.en: To appreciate how absurd that is,

cues.zh: 想象一下我们在生活中其他事情上也这么做。
cues.en: imagine if we did other things in our life that way.

cues.en: Do what you can."

cues.zh: （笑声）

cues.en: I'll give it an 80 percent."

cues.en: You say, "Great! That's a C. Let's build the first floor."

cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.en: Same thing.

cues.en: We have two weeks, do what you can, inspector shows up, it's a 75 percent.

cues.en: Great, that's a D-plus.

cues.zh: 二楼、三楼，
cues.en: Second floor, third floor,

cues.zh: 如果你的反应是教育中常见的反应，
cues.en: And if your reaction is the reaction you typically have in education,

cues.zh: 或者很多人的反应，
cues.en: or that a lot of folks have,

cues.zh: 你可能会说，也许是承包商不行，
cues.en: you might say, maybe we had a bad contractor,

cues.zh: 或者我们需要更好的检查，或者更频繁的检查。
cues.en: or maybe we needed better inspection or more frequent inspection.

cues.zh: 但真正坏掉的是流程。
cues.en: But what was really broken was the process.

cues.zh: 我们在人为地限制做某件事的时间，
cues.en: We were artificially constraining how long we had to something,

cues.zh: 几乎注定了结果会参差不齐，
cues.en: pretty much ensuring a variable outcome,

cues.zh: 我们还费心去检查并找出那些缺口，
cues.en: and we took the trouble of inspecting and identifying those gaps,

cues.zh: 但随后却直接在它上面继续搭建。
cues.en: but then we built right on top of it.

cues.zh: 所以掌握学习的理念恰恰相反。
cues.en: So the idea of mastery learning is to do the exact opposite.

cues.zh: 不是人为地限制、固定
cues.en: Instead of artificially constraining, fixing

cues.zh: 你什么时候做、做多久，
cues.en: when and how long you work on something,

cues.zh: 几乎注定结果参差不齐，
cues.en: pretty much ensuring that variable outcome,

cues.zh: A、B、C、D、F——
cues.en: the A, B, C, D, F --

cues.zh: 而是反过来做。
cues.en: do it the other way around.

cues.zh: 可变的是学生实际需要
cues.en: What's variable is when and how long

cues.zh: 什么时候做、做多久，
cues.en: a student actually has to work on something,

cues.zh: 固定的是他们真正掌握了内容。
cues.en: and what's fixed is that they actually master the material.

cues.zh: 重要的是要意识到
cues.en: And it's important to realize

cues.zh: 这不仅会让学生更好地学习指数运算，
cues.en: that not only will this make the student learn their exponents better,

cues.zh: 还会强化正确的心态肌肉。
cues.en: but it'll reinforce the right mindset muscles.

cues.zh: 它让他们意识到，如果在某件事上错了20%，
cues.en: It makes them realize that if you got 20 percent wrong on something,

cues.zh: 并不意味着你DNA里就刻着个C。
cues.en: it doesn't mean that you have a C branded in your DNA somehow.

cues.zh: 这意味着你应该继续努力。
cues.en: It means that you should just keep working on it.

cues.zh: 你该有毅力，该有恒心，
cues.en: You should have grit; you should have perseverance;

cues.zh: 你该对自己的学习负责。
cues.en: you should take agency over your learning.

cues.zh: 现在，很多怀疑者可能会说，嘿，这些都很好，
cues.en: Now, a lot of skeptics might say, well, hey, this is all great,

cues.zh: 从哲学上讲，这种掌握式学习的理念
cues.en: philosophically, this whole idea of mastery-based learning

cues.zh: 及其与心态的联系，
cues.en: and its connection to mindset,

cues.zh: 学生对自己的学习负责。
cues.en: students taking agency over their learning.

cues.zh: 这很有道理，但似乎不切实际。
cues.en: It makes a lot of sense, but it seems impractical.

cues.zh: 真要实施的话，每个学生都得走自己的进度。
cues.en: To actually do it, every student would be on their own track.

cues.zh: 这必须个性化，
cues.en: It would have to be personalized,

cues.zh: 每个学生都得有私人导师和练习册。
cues.en: you'd have to have private tutors and worksheets for every student.

cues.zh: 这些都不是新想法——
cues.en: And these aren't new ideas --

cues.zh: 100年前，伊利诺伊州温尼特卡就做过实验，
cues.en: there were experiments in Winnetka, Illinois, 100 years ago,

cues.zh: 他们实行精熟学习，效果很好，
cues.en: where they did mastery-based learning and saw great results,

cues.zh: 但他们说这无法规模化，因为后勤上太难了。
cues.en: but they said it wouldn't scale because it was logistically difficult.

cues.zh: 老师得给每个学生不同的练习册，
cues.en: The teacher had to give different worksheets to every student,

cues.zh: 还得按需测评。
cues.en: give on-demand assessments.

cues.zh: 但今天，这不再不切实际了。
cues.en: But now today, it's no longer impractical.

cues.zh: 我们有工具能做到。
cues.en: We have the tools to do it.

cues.zh: 学生想按自己的时间和节奏看讲解？
cues.en: Students see an explanation at their own time and pace?

cues.zh: 有按需视频。
cues.en: There's on-demand video for that.

cues.zh: 他们需要练习？需要反馈？
cues.en: They need practice? They need feedback?

cues.zh: 有现成的自适应练习供学生使用。
cues.en: There's adaptive exercises readily available for students.

cues.zh: 而这一切发生时，各种美妙的事情都会发生。
cues.en: And when that happens, all sorts of neat things happen.

cues.zh: 第一，学生能真正掌握这些概念，
cues.en: One, the students can actually master the concepts,

cues.zh: 同时也在培养成长型思维，
cues.en: but they're also building their growth mindset,

cues.zh: 培养坚毅和毅力，
cues.en: they're building grit, perseverance,

cues.zh: 他们开始对自己的学习负责。
cues.en: they're taking agency over their learning.

cues.zh: 各种美好的事情开始发生
cues.en: And all sorts of beautiful things can start to happen

cues.zh: 在真实的课堂上。
cues.en: in the actual classroom.

cues.zh: 不再是老师单向讲授，
cues.en: Instead of it being focused on the lecture,

cues.zh: 学生可以互相交流。
cues.en: students can interact with each other.

cues.zh: 他们能更深入地掌握学习内容。
cues.en: They can get deeper mastery over the material.

cues.zh: 他们可以进入模拟、苏格拉底式对话。
cues.en: They can go into simulations, Socratic dialogue.

cues.zh: 为了更好地理解我们谈论的内容
cues.en: To appreciate what we're talking about

cues.zh: 以及这里失去潜力的悲剧，
cues.en: and the tragedy of lost potential here,

cues.zh: 我想做一个思想实验。
cues.en: I'd like to give a little bit of a thought experiment.

cues.zh: “你觉得人口中有多大比例的人具备阅读能力？”
cues.en: "What percentage of the population do you think is even capable of reading?"

cues.zh: 他们可能会说：“嗯，有好的教育体系的话，
cues.en: They might say, "Well, with a great education system,
maybe 20 or 30 percent."

cues.zh: 但如果你快进到今天，
cues.en: But if you fast forward to today,

cues.zh: 我们知道那个预测会悲观得离谱，
cues.en: we know that that prediction would have been wildly pessimistic,

cues.zh: 几乎100%的人口都具备阅读能力。
cues.en: that pretty close to 100 percent of the population is capable of reading.

cues.zh: 但如果我问你一个类似的问题：
cues.en: But if I were to ask you a similar question:

cues.zh: “你觉得人口中有多大比例的人
cues.en: "What percentage of the population do you think is capable

cues.zh: 能真正掌握微积分，
cues.en: of truly mastering calculus,

cues.zh: 或者理解有机化学，
cues.en: or understanding organic chemistry,

cues.zh: 或者能为癌症研究做出贡献？”
cues.en: or being able to contribute to cancer research?"

cues.zh: 你们很多人可能会说：“嗯，有好的教育体系的话，
cues.en: A lot of you might say, "Well, with a great education system,
maybe 20, 30 percent."

cues.zh: 但如果这个估计
cues.en: But what if that estimate

cues.zh: 只是基于你自己在非掌握式框架下的经验，
cues.en: is just based on your own experience in a non-mastery framework,

cues.zh: 基于你对自己或对同伴的观察，
cues.en: your own experience with yourself or observing your peers,

cues.zh: 在那个框架里，你被按固定节奏推着上课，
cues.en: where you're being pushed at this set pace through classes,

cues.zh: 不断累积各种知识漏洞？
cues.en: accumulating all these gaps?

cues.zh: 就算你考了95分，
cues.en: Even when you got that 95 percent,

cues.zh: 你丢的那5分是什么？
cues.en: what was that five percent you missed?

cues.zh: 漏洞不断累积——到了高级课程，
cues.en: And it keeps accumulating -- you get to an advanced class,

cues.zh: 你突然撞上一堵墙，说：
cues.en: all of a sudden you hit a wall and say,

cues.zh: “我天生就不是做癌症研究的料；
cues.en: "I'm not meant to be a cancer researcher;

cues.zh: 不是做物理学家的料；不是做数学家的料。”
cues.en: not meant to be a physicist; not meant to be a mathematician."

cues.zh: 我怀疑情况确实如此，
cues.en: I suspect that that actually is the case,

cues.zh: 但如果你被允许在掌握式框架下学习，
cues.en: but if you were allowed to be operating in a mastery framework,

cues.zh: 如果你能真正对自己的学习拥有主动权，
cues.en: if you were allowed to really take agency over your learning,

cues.zh: 当你做错的时候，
cues.en: and when you get something wrong,

cues.zh: 拥抱它——把失败看作学习的时刻——
cues.en: embrace it -- view that failure as a moment of learning --

cues.zh: 那个数字，真正能掌握微积分
cues.en: that number, the percent that could really master calculus

cues.zh: 或理解有机化学的比例，
cues.en: or understand organic chemistry,

cues.zh: 其实要接近100%。
cues.en: is actually a lot closer to 100 percent.

cues.zh: 而这甚至不只是“锦上添花”。
cues.en: And this isn't even just a "nice to have."

cues.zh: 我认为这是一种社会必然。
cues.en: I think it's a social imperative.

cues.zh: 我们正在告别所谓的工业时代，
cues.en: We're exiting what you could call the industrial age

cues.zh: 迈入这场信息革命。
cues.en: and we're going into this information revolution.

cues.zh: 很明显，一些变化正在发生。
cues.en: And it's clear that some things are happening.

cues.zh: 在工业时代，社会是一个金字塔。
cues.en: In the industrial age, society was a pyramid.

cues.zh: 金字塔的底层，需要的是人力劳动。
cues.en: At the base of the pyramid, you needed human labor.

cues.zh: 金字塔的中层，是信息处理，
cues.en: In the middle of the pyramid, you had an information processing,

cues.zh: 一个官僚阶层，
cues.en: a bureaucracy class,

cues.zh: 而金字塔的顶端，是资本所有者、
cues.en: and at the top of the pyramid, you had your owners of capital

cues.zh: 企业家
cues.en: and your entrepreneurs

cues.zh: 以及创意阶层。
cues.en: and your creative class.

cues.zh: 但我们已经知道正在发生什么，
cues.en: But we know what's happening already,

cues.zh: 随着我们迈入这场信息革命。
cues.en: as we go into this information revolution.

cues.zh: 金字塔的底层——自动化，将会接管。
cues.en: The bottom of that pyramid, automation, is going to take over.

cues.zh: 甚至中间那一层，信息处理，
cues.en: Even that middle tier, information processing,

cues.zh: 那正是计算机擅长的事。
cues.en: that's what computers are good at.

cues.zh: 所以作为一个社会，我们面临一个问题：
cues.en: So as a society, we have a question:

cues.zh: 所有这些新的生产力都源于这项技术，
cues.en: All this new productivity is happening because of this technology,

cues.zh: 但谁能参与其中？
cues.en: but who participates in it?

cues.zh: 是只有金字塔最顶端的人参与，如果是这样，
cues.en: Is it just going to be that very top of the pyramid, in which case,

cues.zh: 其他人做什么？
cues.en: what does everyone else do?

cues.zh: 他们如何运作？
cues.en: How do they operate?

cues.zh: 还是我们做一些更有抱负的事情？
cues.en: Or do we do something that's more aspirational?

cues.zh: 我们是否真的尝试倒转金字塔，
cues.en: Do we actually attempt to invert the pyramid,

cues.zh: 让庞大的创意阶层存在，
cues.en: where you have a large creative class,

cues.zh: 让几乎每个人都能作为创业者、
cues.en: where almost everyone can participate as an entrepreneur,

cues.zh: 艺术家、研究者参与其中？
cues.en: an artist, as a researcher?

cues.zh: 我不认为这是乌托邦。
cues.en: And I don't think that this is utopian.

cues.zh: 我真的认为这一切都基于一个理念：
cues.en: I really think that this is all based on the idea

cues.zh: 如果我们让人们挖掘自己的潜力，
cues.en: that if we let people tap into their potential

cues.zh: 通过掌握概念，
cues.en: by mastering concepts,

cues.zh: 通过能够对自己的学习行使自主权，
cues.en: by being able to exercise agency over their learning,

cues.zh: 他们就能达到那里。
cues.en: that they can get there.

cues.zh: 而当你作为一个世界公民来思考这件事时，
cues.en: And when you think of it as just a citizen of the world,

cues.zh: 这相当令人兴奋。
cues.en: it's pretty exciting.

cues.zh: 我是说，想想我们能拥有什么样的公平，
cues.en: I mean, think about the type of equity we can we have,

cues.zh: 以及文明能进步的速度。
cues.en: and the rate at which civilization could even progress.

cues.zh: 所以，我对此相当乐观。
cues.en: And so, I'm pretty optimistic about it.

cues.zh: 我觉得活在当下会是非常激动人心的时代。
cues.en: I think it's going to be a pretty exciting time to be alive.

cues.zh: 谢谢。
cues.en: Thank you.

cues.zh: （掌声）
cues.en: (Applause)
